title: 국제민사사법공조규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Statement of Expenses for Judicial Cooperation)
(1) Where a party has paid in advance the expenses prescribed in Article 9 of the Act, the head of the court to which the presiding judge seeking judicial cooperation belongs shall state that fact in a request for service under Article 6 (1) of the Act.
(2) The Director General of the National Court Administration shall state in a request for service under Article 6 (2) of the Act that the requesting court will collect from the party concerned an amount equivalent to expenses paid or advanced by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade or an overseas diplomatic mission for service of documents or examination of evidence, and pay it into the National Treasury. <Amended on June 28, 2002>
